## Standardization Applied

All files include these fields in order:
- name: Prompt identifier (kebab-case)
- title: Human-readable title
- description: Brief description
- version: Version number (X.Y.Z format)
- tags: Array of 5-12 categorization tags
- trigger: Command/trigger string
- metadata: Nested configuration structure

### Tag Categories

### Metadata Structure

- hermes: profile, priority, categories
- copilot: model_required, context_length

- codex: enabled, model_preferred
